popup.sel_first_tcp: Picked automatically: first TCP node (ping not measured yet)
popup.sel_only_udp_or_lte: Picked automatically: no other nodes (UDP or LTE only)
popup.mode_ru_d: Russia direct, the rest through VPN
popup.mode_direct_d: VPN is not used for sites
popup.kill_d: Kill-switch: nothing leaks if the link drops

warn.happ: The VPN in the Happ app is on. Turn the VPN off in the Happ app, then press "Check again".
warn.happ_long: The VPN in the Happ app is on (its core or the happ-xray tunnel is running). Two VPNs at once break routing, so Serpantinum VPN will not start. Turn the VPN off in the Happ app, then press "Check again". The Happ app and service themselves are left alone.
warn.service: The system service is not installed: see the "VPN" tab
warn.polkit: The service polkit rule is missing: see the "VPN" tab
warn.tun: This Xray build has no TUN

reason.happ_active: The VPN in the Happ app is on: turn it off in the Happ app and press "Check again"
reason.service_missing: The system service is not installed
reason.start_timeout: The core did not answer in time
reason.no_connectivity: No connectivity through the node, VPN was turned off automatically
reason.server_dns: Could not resolve the address of server {name}
reason.proxy_unreachable: The node server is not responding

error.http_error: The subscription server returned an error
error.network: No network to the subscription server
error.no_digest: No checksum for the geo list
error.happ_active: The VPN in the Happ app is on: turn it off in the Happ app and press "Check again"

tab.check_ok: The config passes the Xray check
tab.core_missing: Core not found: install the xray package
tab.service_none: Not installed: needed once, with administrator rights
tab.polkit_unknown: polkit rule not checkable (directory not readable by the user)
tab.url_placeholder: Paste the subscription link (kept only in a file with mode 600)
tab.format_d: Xray JSON if the panel serves it; otherwise parse links
tab.kill_d: Without VPN the internet is blocked instead of leaking
tab.autodisable_d: No connectivity for {n} s: routes are removed, the internet returns
tab.ping_method_d: HTTP GET and HEAD go through the node itself and work for any protocol, UDP included
tab.ping_url_d: Any http(s) address that answers with a 2xx code
tab.ping_timeout_d: How many seconds to wait for the node
tab.ping_display_d: How latency is shown in the node list
tab.geo_none: Missing: the "Russia direct" mode only matches .ru/.рф/.su domains
tab.proxy_d: Comma separated domains, take priority over "Russia direct"
